summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Altares del Alma (Entregas 1+2) via Playwright at 1920px and 360px. Covered 18 requested scenarios: welcome/first launch, first and second space creation with contact registration and consent, Tus datos/baja, dashboard header (no float animation, editable name, phrase add/suggest/edit/remove persisting after reload), 5 portal modules with empty and filled previews and correct plural counters, Cartas (sobres, reader actions, TXT+PDF downloads, delete+Deshacer, draft recovery, quota-fail keeps editor open with save-fail-notice), Oráculo (hints, origin, actions visible without hover, shuffle+skip, button disabled during shuffle, ?consultar=1), Galería (upload png/jpg, folders with previews, rename, move, delete folder with move-to-General and delete-all, caption, multi-select bar, lightbox, delete+undo), Libro (default title, custom title/subtitle, back cover with same title + placeholder + review + closing + editorial credit, renaming space keeps custom title, add/reorder pages, import from photos/letters/moments with 'Ya está en el libro', PDF), Timeline (with/without date, stable order, edit/delete+undo), backup all/per space (format+version 2, no contact data), restore preview/cancel/merge copy/skip/replace with ack, corrupt and future-version files rejected, legacy {espacios} file imported as Tito with 1 letter, Trash (count, restore, purge with confirm), corrupt storage gate (raw value not overwritten until confirm; download raw; restore from gate), automatic migration from mensajes_ancestrales_v1, /avatar/:id(/sub) redirects, 360px responsive (no horizontal overflow on 7 routes), no 'avatar'/'ítems' word in UI. One real bug found: RestoreDialog keeps its previous mode/ack/dup state between openings, which can silently replace all data.

ui_bugs.issue: The mode/dup/ack state stays the same between restore sessions because the component never unmounts (it only returns null when data is missing). Reproduction: open restore with any file, pick 'Reemplazar todo', tick restore-replace-ack, click Cancelar. Then upload another file. The dialog opens with 'Reemplazar todo' already selected and the ack already ticked, so one click on Restaurar wipes all existing spaces. Confirmed: a later legacy-file restore replaced Rosa+Nuevo with only Tito. The dup choice (copy/overwrite/skip) carries over the same way.

issues: The welcome modal opens on top of storage-gate when altares_welcome_seen is not set. A user with unreadable data is not a first-time user, so hide the welcome while boot.status is corrupt or inaccessible, or when data already exists or was migrated.
After clicking 'Deshacer' no confirmation toast appears. Minor.

action_items: HIGH: Reset RestoreDialog state each time a new backup is loaded. Either add useEffect(() => { setMode('merge'); setDup('copy'); setAck(false); }, [data]) or render it with key={restoreData?.exportedAt + Date.now()}. Use conditional mounting ({restoreData && <RestoreDialog .../>}) in Home.jsx.
LOW: Do not show the Welcome modal when boot.status is corrupt, inaccessible or migrated (or when there are already spaces).

LOW (code review): SpaceForm saves the contact (saveContact + syncContact) before createAvatar. If the space write fails (quota), the contact is still recorded. Consider saving the contact only after the space is created successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: RestoreDialog state persists across openings and can lead to silent full replacement (see ui_bugs).
SpaceForm: contact is saved before onCreate, so it is not atomic with the space creation.
saveContact ignores the writeContact() return value. If writing the contact fails, the UI still proceeds as if it was saved.
removeItem undo: if the user navigates away, the toast action still runs updateAvatar. That is fine, but undo gives no feedback toast.
StorageGate restore applies directly without a preview, which differs from the Home restore flow. Acceptable, but could reuse RestoreDialog.

success_rate.frontend: 97% (all 18 scenarios pass functionally; 1 HIGH state bug in restore dialog)

test_credentials: None required (no auth). /app/memory/test_credentials.md is outdated: it mentions old 'Respaldar recuerdos' labels and the array format.
seed_data_creation: Seeded localStorage directly per scenario (ma_data_v1 with spaces s1/s2, altares_welcome_seen). Test backup files in /tmp/bk (valid.json, legacy.json, corrupt.json, future.json) and images /tmp/img0.png,/tmp/img1.png,/tmp/img2.jpg.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SPA with localStorage only. Clear localStorage between scenarios and set altares_welcome_seen='1' to skip the welcome. Header phrase remove button (header-phrase-remove) is inside the edit modal, so open header-phrase-edit first. Trash purge confirm: [data-testid=trash-purge-confirm] [data-testid=confirm-accept]. Import items testid: libro-import-item-{src}, use the prefix selector. Retest: open restore → choose replace+ack → cancel → open another file → it must default to merge with ack unchecked.
rca of the issue: RestoreDialog is rendered unconditionally in Home.jsx (<RestoreDialog data={restoreData} .../>). Its useState hooks (mode, dup, ack) start once on mount and never reset because the component only returns null when data is null and stays mounted. Fix: mount it conditionally or reset the state in useEffect when data changes.
